description: WRITE. Purge the cached content of one pull zone — everything, or only files carrying a cache tag. Nothing is lost (the CDN refetches from the origin) but the origin takes the refill load. bunny.net: POST /pullzone/{id}/purgeCache.

cache_tag.description: Only purge files with this cache tag.

name: bunny_purge_pull_zone_cache
title: Purge a pull zone's cache
